description: The function MAX() is aggregate function. Returns the maximum value of the expression in the grouped rows.
An aggregate function generates summary results, simultaneously operating on several database rows.
The output is generated based on the group of rows.
A code snippet for getting the result of an aggregate function MAX(). The result of the function can be NULL.
body: var maxId *int64 // a pointer is used here because the result of the function can be NULL
query := fmt.Sprintf(`SELECT MAX(id) FROM items WHERE id >= %d`, 0)
